title: Water supply problem
shortDescription: Combo cannot fill within the allowed time.
fullDescription: Samsung washer-dryer combos display 4C when the inlet valve cannot fill the tub fast enough. Closed taps, kinked hoses, or a clogged inlet screen are typical causes.

fixSteps.title: Open taps
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm both hot and cold taps are fully open.

fixSteps.title: Straighten hose
fixSteps.instruction: Pull the unit out and remove kinks in supply hoses.

fixSteps.title: Clean screens
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew hose ends and rinse the inlet screens.

whenToCallPro: Call if 4C persists with screens clear.

title: Drain problem
shortDescription: Tub did not drain in the allowed time.
fullDescription: 5C indicates the pump cannot empty the tub. Lint clogs, debris in the filter, or a failed pump are typical causes.

fixSteps.title: Drain via hose
fixSteps.instruction: Use the small emergency drain hose at front-bottom.

fixSteps.title: Clean filter
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew the debris filter and clear lint and coins.

fixSteps.title: Test pump
fixSteps.instruction: If still 5C, replace the drain pump.

whenToCallPro: Call if pump replacement worries you.

title: Unbalanced load
shortDescription: Tub cannot reach spin speed due to imbalance.
fullDescription: Ub indicates the tub is too unbalanced for safe spin. Bunched sheets, heavy single items, or a worn shock absorber are typical causes.

fixSteps.title: Redistribute
fixSteps.instruction: Open the door and rearrange the load.

fixSteps.title: Level unit
fixSteps.instruction: Adjust the feet so the unit is rock-solid.

fixSteps.title: Replace shocks
fixSteps.instruction: Replace shocks if the tub bounces excessively.

whenToCallPro: Call if shock replacement is too involved.

title: Drying temperature sensor fault
shortDescription: Dry-cycle thermistor reads out of range.
fullDescription: tC indicates the dryer thermistor reports an open or shorted reading. Drying programs are blocked until the sensor is replaced.

fixSteps.title: Clean lint filter
fixSteps.instruction: Pull the lint filter and rinse it.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: If tC persists, replace the dryer thermistor.

whenToCallPro: Call if you cannot reach the dryer ducting.

title: Door not locked
fullDescription: dC indicates the door switch reports the door is open or unlocked when starting. Check the door for crumbs in the catch and verify the lock fires.

fixSteps.title: Clean catch
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the door catch and the strike on the front frame.

whenToCallPro: Call if you cannot remove the boot clamp safely.

faq.q: How do I open the door if dC won't clear?
faq.a: Drain the unit and pull the manual release tab.

title: Motor tach fault
fullDescription: 3C indicates the motor controller does not see the expected tach signal. Worn brushes, loose plug, or failed control are typical.

fixSteps.title: Service motor
fixSteps.instruction: If 3C persists, the motor or control needs service.

whenToCallPro: Most owners should call a tech.

faq.a: Sometimes after a power cycle, but the issue usually returns.

title: Heater fault
fullDescription: HC indicates the wash or dry heater is open, shorted, or its thermal cutoff opened. Limescale and lint are common causes.

fixSteps.title: Run descale
fixSteps.instruction: Run the self-clean cycle with descaler if applicable.

fixSteps.title: Replace heater
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the heating element after removing the boot.

whenToCallPro: Call if heater access scares you.

faq.a: Yes, cold-water programs may still work.

title: Leak detected
shortDescription: Base sensor detected water in the catch pan.
fullDescription: LC indicates the base water sensor is wet. Loose hoses, a torn boot, or pump leak are typical causes.

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Tilt the unit and look for water source on the floor pan.

fixSteps.title: Repair leak
fixSteps.instruction: Tighten clamps, replace boot, or service pump as required.

whenToCallPro: Call if leak source is hidden.

faq.a: No, water and electricity is dangerous.

title: Wash temperature sensor fault
shortDescription: Wash thermistor reads out of range.
fullDescription: EC indicates the wash temperature sensor is reporting open or shorted. The cycle defaults to cold rinse and limits programs.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the wash thermistor next to the heater.

whenToCallPro: Call if heater bay access worries you.

title: Pressure sensor fault
shortDescription: Water level sensor signal out of range.
fullDescription: 1C indicates the pressure sensor or its hose to the tub is not reporting correct values. Kinked or clogged pressure hose is the most common cause.

fixSteps.title: Inspect hose
fixSteps.instruction: Pull the small clear pressure hose and rinse the trap.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Replace pressure sensor on the top of the chassis.

whenToCallPro: Call if you cannot remove the top panel.
